about: Static text for the unit panels of the interactive PFD: stream names, governing equations, literature sources and limitations. Live values come from the engine reply and validation rows from data/validation.json. Equation labels are those of the derivations (math/eq_register.csv). A source lists the sections of the project report that cite it; a source no report section cites says so, and a source not read at its origin is marked not verified.
caption: Layout follows the project's Figure 2. The dashed line holds the reformer train, the MEA plant, the recycle compressor, the cryogenic unit, the CO₂ compressor and the ship to offshore storage. The PSA sits outside it as an external block with no simulation, and its reject crosses the line on the way back. Offshore storage is a tariff with no simulation. Stream tags are the stream ids of results/Integrated_Mass_Balance.csv, and a ring marks a stream that file lists as crossing the boundary; the feed, steam and condensate cross at their open ends. Lines tagged P, H, L, C or R have no row in that file, since the flowsheet treats them as inside a unit. The reformer block holds S04, the shift block S06 to S09A, the separator S09C, and the burner air COMBUSTION_O2 is not drawn. The drawing shows one helium circulator; the engine counts the secondary circulator too, in that panel. The recycle compressor and the cryogenic unit are drawn apart and modelled as one unit.

htgr.summary: Generic helium-cooled reactor that supplies all process heat through the IHX, with a branch to the power block.

sources.locator: Table 2 and its continuation, PDF pp17 to 18

limitations.text: The design basis is a generic {{units.htgr.conditions.ROT.value|0}}°C HTGR. No commercial reactor runs at this outlet, and Xe-100 is only a labelled analogue with a much lower outlet temperature.
The decay heat limit at this rating and outlet temperature is unchecked.
Heat beyond the process need is held as margin and earns no revenue.
The anchored port reports heat shortfall as grid import and has no unmet thermal demand field.

limitations.text: On the assumed tube (Hoseinzade and Adams geometry with the JAERI finned helium annulus) and helium supplied at {{units.smr.conditions.T_HE_SUPPLY.value|0}}°C, the tube model found no tube count in its search range that reaches the {{units.smr.conditions.SYNGAS_CHAIN_C5_HPS_GEN1_T_IN_C.value|0}}°C exit. The two lower exit temperatures of the reformer exit sensitivity, flowsheet runs FS_B_REC_F_T825 and FS_B_REC_F_T800, are reachable. The design exit therefore stays INL's equilibrium assumption, and the Headline solve does not use the tube model.
The A-2 run sets the single tuned catalyst activity, and the held-back runs miss the measured methane conversion.
The Xu and Froment rates are extrapolated well above the temperature and pressure of their data.
Process heat is the total heat to the reformer train and includes preheat.
Ahn and Lee's heat basis gives a different duty that this model has not reconciled; the dashboard shows the surplus on both bases.
The Level 3 carbon comparison failed, so the gas feed term T13 stays on its anchored value.
The equilibrium layer misses INL's printed conventional reformer conversion.

absorber.summary: Packed column where {{inputs.w_mea|0}} wt% MEA takes CO₂ out of the shifted syngas at pressure.

sources.locator: Eqs 10 to 17, PDF pp3 to 4; Table 2

limitations.text: The pilot absorber benchmark misses, and the high-pressure runs sit far below the measured removal. The column gate failed, so the Headline solve keeps the fixed per-pass capture and the column model runs only in the validation harness.
No pilot has run aqueous MEA on shifted syngas at this pressure.
No solubility data exist in MEA for H₂ or the other light gases, and solvent property data end near the rich loading cap of {{units.absorber.conditions.LOADING_RICH.value|2}} mol/mol.
The liquid to gas ratio is far above that of flue-gas pilots.
The literature on solvent choice is mixed, so Selexol and activated MDEA stay as sensitivities.

cryogenic.summary: Returns a CH₄-rich recycle to the reformer feed and H₂ to the PSA feed. The N₂-rich cut goes to the stack.

sources.locator: A-16 and A-18, PDF p40 and p42; Table 2 and A-53

limitations.text: The Level 3 flowsheet and the anchored ledger disagree on the carbon split after the shift, four carbon lines miss (tube, tail gas, recycled, burned), and term T04 stays on its anchored value.
CO₂ slip into this unit is about ten times INL's, and freeze-out and reverse shift are unquantified, so INL's recycle may not transfer to MEA.
The burned N₂-rich cut leaves to the atmosphere and is counted in the emissions.
